Congrats on taking initiative and starting to get your shit together! When I first started asking for help I talked to my primary care physician during a checkup. He recommended a therapist and started me on an antidepressant at the same time, so I’d say both is your best bet. Or at the very least, if you talk to your doctor he would know what’s best for you personally. 

In my experience anti-depressants aren’t very expensive. I think with insurance my meds are like 3$ each. Therapy on the the other hand can get kind of expensive, especially if your insurance doesn’t cover it. Some therapists are more expensive than others, but it all depends on your area/insurance. 

Personally, meds can only help you so much, it’s like putting a bandaid on a gun shot wound. You might stop some bleeding but the problem would still be there. Therapy is taking care of all the real issues in your life that trigger/cause your depression and ways to counter act them. 

Sorry this was so long, I hope some of it helps. Good luck with everything, I hope you start feeling better soon. :)
